lead.h: Workplace messaging launches "polite mode": every reply gets a full stop
p: The new version turns "polite mode" on by default: before sending, it adds the full stop and changes "ok" to "Okay." The maker says conflict in teams fell by 70% during testing.
What teams said to each other also fell by 70% during testing. The maker did not mention that.
